capabilities: Navigate notes in a Dendron-like dotted hierarchy via a tree view
Scaffold virtual child notes and folders with rule-based suggestions
Move, rename, and delete files and folders with drag-and-drop and dialogs
Select multiple files and folders for bulk move, hide, and trash actions
Create redirect stub notes to show one note at alternate tree locations
disambiguation: The name refers to dotted note hierarchies (a.b.c), not Graphviz dot files or a generic file navigator.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; until official release it is installed via the BRAT plugin. Mobile-first design with IndexedDB caching for large vaults. English and French localization only.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer shows notes by folder and does not render dotted note names (a.b.c) as an expandable tree, making deep hierarchical vaults hard to navigate and scaffold.

relations.evidence: Dendron for the inspiration on hierarchical note management

summary: Tree view that presents Dendron-style dotted notes as a navigable hierarchy, with rule-based suggestions, drag-and-drop moves, and multi-select actions.
